metadata.description: Simple Drawing Pad: sketch an idea by hand with a graphics tablet, mouse or touch screen and let Claude look at it (drawing window on Windows, a browser board elsewhere).

plugins.name: simple-drawing-pad
plugins.description:
Sketch an idea by hand and paste it to Claude or any app.
Ctrl+Alt+D opens the drawing window, Enter copies, Ctrl+V pastes. Simple as that. A small helper is built on your PC from the included source (nothing downloaded, no admin rights): local only, no network, collects nothing, starts with Windows. It asks once per computer before installing, and a short local check at each session start tells Claude if it works. Remove it in Windows Settings > Apps. For Windows PCs only.
